text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the final stretch!
Who will seize the glory of the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*, *gasp*...
*Pant*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(...It hurts. It's suffocating. It's so hard, I want to stop.
I can't take any more of this. My lungs feel like they're going to burst—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Forward, forward... keep moving forward...!!
Hyaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No! I will take the lead!!
This race, this Derby is where
my name will be... etched!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I don't want to.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to lose, I don't want to lose, I don't want to lose!
This is my Derby!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-san and my—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's the Derbyyyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *pant*, *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-And yet. I-I'm...
I just...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh—...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tasting the bitter sting of defeat,
Sakura Chiyono O wept and wailed, her face a mess of tears.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, I couldn't let her come to a halt here.
choice_data_list: ...Let's accept this defeat and overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Still, this Derby is...
This Derby is my... goal, and...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And now it's over...
Everything that made me, me—
choice_data_list: No, you still had a goal to strive for
No, you still have a goal you haven't achieved yet

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "So, when that happens...! Would you... run with the stronger me again...?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: There's no time to stand still!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes......
I'm so sorry, that's right......

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I want to become like Maruzen-san,
if I want to stand beside her, if I want to win...
I'm still falling so far short, aren't I...?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah, Chiyo-chan.
You've truly become a strong Umamusume, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for carrying my feelings with you.
I'll never forget watching this Derby for the rest of my life."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "...So this time, it's my turn. Let's fulfill our final promise."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Run with me—
and please accept this gift from me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With excitement still lingering in Tokyo Racecourse,
Sakura Chiyono O and the others carve out a renewed resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened at that precious milestone—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Wait up.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Don't let it end in such an "ordinary" way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O was all packed up and ready to go.
Together, the two of us stepped out of the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Once it all started, the road to the Derby went by in the blink of an eye, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I realized something.
Where I first started from...
was simply 'I want to win the Derby.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after Maruzen-san,
receiving Maruzen-san's feelings...
That's why I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But before I knew it,
"I don't want to lose" was added to that.
That feeling gave my legs strength, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: In that split second before the finish line, I found myself wishing that this moment would never end.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "I want to keep competing forever, as their rival. I want to keep running on and on, forever and ever."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Having a rival really is an amazing thing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, alright!
Now, what shall we do next?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now that the primary goal is done, should I take on
the Kikuka Sho or the Tenno Sho (Autumn) to gain the strength
needed to compete with Maruzen-sanâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!!)

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
A-An ambulance!! Hurry!!
Someone over there, please grab a stretcher!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san has...
Mejiro Ardan has collapsed!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the concert, the wail of an ambulance suddenly echoed out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O turned pale as a sheet,
holding Mejiro Ardan's hand and continually calling out to her
as she was carried away to the hospital on a stretcher.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having received those words of encouragement, Mejiro Ardan,
her face still beaded with sweat, clasped the offered hand in return
...and gave a satisfied smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The results of the detailed examination revealed that, due to the strain she had put on them until now, Mejiro Ardan's legs had become extremely fragile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her life became a cycle of hospital visits and admissions for treatment...
and it seems there is still no clear prospect of her returning to the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...You came to
visit me in the hospital, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ardan-san.
Um... well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Please, don't tense up so much.
I was fully prepared for this price."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And this is also proof of a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because I was frail, I was far more sensitive
to my own body than others. ...To my limits, as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Before I even realized it, being conscious of that was
eating away at me. Whispering that I shouldn't go any further,
that I must never step beyond this line.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still, seeing you say you'd defy "normalcy,"
seeing you struggle against what was given to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am ready to pour my entire soul into racing you.
I was able to touch what lies beyond my limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"And since I was able to witness that miracle,
I have no regrets left in this world."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... Does that mean......!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Preparations are already underway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Chiyono O. From now on, you are
sure to face many new rivals."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However, please remember that Mejiro Ardan was among them.
Remember that there was an Umamusume who defied fate and sought to shine with all her might."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I won't forget.
I will never forget.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So please don't forget, Ardan-san.
That you have a rival in me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I swear I will make you regret this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Rivals are amazing, you know?
Whenever you feel that urge not to lose to them,
you can draw out dozens of times more strength than usual.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Right before the Derby's finish line. Surely you must have felt it too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"So even if you have no regrets now,
as long as I remain in your heart as your rival."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You'll surely want to compete with those legs again.
You'll want to challenge each other once more...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'll make sure to become your biggest regret.
When that time comes, let's race again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then.
choice_data_list: Do you really have no regrets at all?
Do you truly have no regrets at all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ......Yes, with no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you just tell me
that you have no regrets...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I'm going to get
much, much stronger, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Even when we fight next time, I won't lose...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding back her tears, Sakura Chiyono O trembled.
She had gained yet another layer of strength.
